entries.translation: 金色的汗珠沿著他的下顎線滑落。

entries.source: Discomforted in the unrelenting heat he stripped back his shirt sleeves and with passing humor noted the development of his sunburns. Within a month he doubted even his closest of kin would recognize him; his moonlight pale skin tinged a light almond color and his brownish hair streaked with golden highlights. All things considered, he felt very differently about himself now, felt more aware that there were bigger problems in the world than his own. Still, it was difficult not to dwell on his sudden...disability.
entries.translation: 在毫不留情的炎熱中渾身不自在，他把襯衫袖子捲了起來，帶著一絲自嘲注意到自己曬傷的進展。他懷疑不出一個月，就連最親的親人也認不出他來：他那月光般蒼白的皮膚染上了淡淡的杏仁色，褐色的頭髮則挑染出金色的光澤。種種考量下來，他此刻對自己的感覺很不一樣了，更清楚這世上還有比他自己更大的難題。話雖如此，要不去反覆想著自己這突如其來的…殘缺，仍是件難事。

entries.source: Owyn contemplated resuming the meditations that had occupied him the length of the morning, but decided that in the space of four hours he had learned nothing he hadn't already deduced intuitively. For some reason, his magical abilities were useless in this alien environment and the prospect frightened him nearly beyond reason.
entries.translation: 歐文考慮著要不要繼續那佔去他整個上午的冥想，但他斷定，這四個鐘頭裡他並沒有學到任何憑直覺推想不出的東西。不知為何，他的法術能力在這個異界環境中毫無用處，而這個前景嚇得他幾乎失去理智。

entries.source: "Another week beneath this strange sun and I shall seem pale next to you." Gorath shouted as he hiked back up the path, the dark strands of his hair dancing in a hot breeze. "This magician Pug must walk without leaving footprints! I can find no evidence of him. How progress your meditations?"
entries.translation: 「在這古怪的太陽底下再待一個禮拜，站在你旁邊我都要顯得蒼白了。」戈拉斯沿著小徑往回爬時喊道，深色的髮絲在熱風中舞動。「這個叫帕格的法師走路想必不留腳印！我找不到任何他經過的痕跡。你的冥想進展如何？」

entries.source: Owyn shrugged. "No luck. I've tried everything from lesser path cantrips to greater path incantations. Nothing works. It's almost as if there were no manna here."
entries.translation: 歐文聳了聳肩。「沒有收穫。從小徑法門的小咒到大徑法門的長咒，我什麼都試過了。全都不管用。這裡幾乎像是沒有法力似的。」

entries.source: Arching his brows inquisitively, Gorath motioned for the boy to continue.
entries.translation: 戈拉斯疑惑地揚起眉，示意男孩說下去。

entries.source: "Most people misunderstand the way that magic works," Owyn explained. "As a magician, I don't have power within me. All I know are a series of words and actions that help me gather the power, or manna, from the natural world. If, however, there is no manna for me to collect, then all of my magical training is futile. I'm powerless."
entries.translation: 「多數人都誤解了法術運作的方式。」歐文解釋道。「身為法師，我體內並沒有力量。我所知道的，只是一連串能幫我從自然界中匯聚力量——也就是法力——的字句與動作。可要是根本沒有法力供我採集，那我所有的法術訓練就全是白費。我沒有力量了。」

entries.source: "Would the same be true of Pug?"
Owyn nodded. "He would be as helpless as I am, worse perhaps. If I were accustomed to having the kind of command that he has and suddenly lost it..."
entries.translation: 歐文點了點頭。「他會跟我一樣無助，說不定更糟。要是我早已習慣擁有他那種掌控力，卻突然失去它…」

entries.source: "He could be in very dire danger," Gorath said, finishing the thought. Leaning over, he fetched Owyn's staff from where it lay discarded in the sand. "I think that makes our journey all the more urgent."
entries.translation: 「他可能正身陷極大的險境。」戈拉斯替他把話說完。他俯下身，從沙地裡被丟在一旁的地方撿起歐文的法杖。「我想，這讓我們的旅程更加刻不容緩了。」
